name: vibe-verifier-changed-code-mutation
description: The pinned toolchain for the changed-code-mutation gate: StrykerJS, its Vitest runner plugin, and typescript, which Stryker imports beside itself to rewrite a project's tsconfig.json for its sandbox. The project's own Vitest is the one that runs; vitest-stub only satisfies the plugin's static import and fails loudly if it is ever reached.

allowInDependencies.@stryker-mutator/core: this package is the changed-code-mutation gate's pinned toolchain: running it is its only job, installed by the gate's npm ci
allowInDependencies.@stryker-mutator/vitest-runner: this package is the changed-code-mutation gate's pinned toolchain: running it is its only job, installed by the gate's npm ci
allowInDependencies.typescript: this package is the changed-code-mutation gate's pinned toolchain: running it is its only job, installed by the gate's npm ci
allowInDependencies.vitest: this package is the changed-code-mutation gate's pinned toolchain: running it is its only job, installed by the gate's npm ci
